name: Wo Qin'ai de Meimei
source:
That day, you were born, together with a younger sister. That day, your parents remarried, and you got a younger sister. That day, you ran into someone in the neighborhood, and it turned out to be a younger sister. Great, it’s a younger sister! We are saved!

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492320/]Steam[/url]]
